title: Cattle mutilations in the Bigelow era

tellings.quote: uh during the Bigelow era, you know, my predecessor, they did have many cattle mutilation events where

plain: Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property famous for strange reports, is said to have had many cattle mutilations, cows found dead and cut in odd ways, while it was owned by the businessman Robert Bigelow from 1996 to about 2016. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, tells it about his predecessor's time, pointing to Bigelow's necropsy reports, animal autopsies, and a doctor he names as Dr. O'nett. To the tellers it is part of why the ranch is seen as a hotspot for the unexplained.
